# Сценарий сверки: команды отсортированных множеств, score/lex-семейство.

# --- подготовка ---
ZADD z 1 a 2 b 3 c 4 d 5 e
ZADD z 2 aa 2 bb
ZADD lex 0 a 0 aa 0 b 0 bb 0 c

# --- инкременты и чтение ---
ZINCRBY z 1.5 a
ZSCORE z a
ZCOUNT z 2 4
ZCOUNT z (2 +inf
ZCOUNT z -inf +inf
ZMSCORE z a b nosuch
ZLEXCOUNT lex [a [b
ZLEXCOUNT lex - +

# --- диапазоны по score ---
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 2 4
ZRANGEBYSCORE z (2 4
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 2 3 WITHSCORES
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 1 5 LIMIT 1 2
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 1 5 LIMIT 0 3
ZREVRANGEBYSCORE z 4 2
ZREVRANGEBYSCORE z 4 2 WITHSCORES

# --- диапазоны по ZRANGE с опциями ---
ZRANGE z 2 4 BYSCORE
ZRANGE z 4 2 BYSCORE REV
ZRANGE z 0 2 REV
ZRANGE z 0 2
ZRANGE z 2 4 BYSCORE LIMIT 1 2

# --- диапазоны по lex ---
ZRANGEBYLEX lex [a (c
ZRANGEBYLEX lex [a (c LIMIT 1 2
ZREVRANGEBYLEX lex (c [a
ZRANGE lex [a (c BYLEX
ZRANGE lex (c [a BYLEX REV

# --- ошибки ---
ZCOUNT z bad 4
ZCOUNT z 1 bad
ZRANGEBYLEX lex a b
ZLEXCOUNT lex a b
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 1
ZINCRBY z notafloat m
